overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: both meeting notices listed topics specific enough to reasonably inform the public of the anticipated discussion and possible votes.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Sept. 25, 2012 notice's 'Building Commissioner Position' topic was too vague to signal a vote to reduce the position from full-time to part-time.
allegations.key_passage: This topic was sufficiently specific to reasonably advise the public that the Board would be discussing, and possibly voting to make changes to, the building commissioner position.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Oct. 16, 2012 notice's 'Audit Committee Update' topic under Appointments was too vague to signal a vote to disband the Audit Committee.
allegations.key_passage: The topic listed in the notice was sufficiently specific to reasonably advise members of the public that the Board would be discussing appointments to the Audit Committee and could take a vote.
